hook: NVIDIA just made a massive move, acquiring Hugging Face for nearly 13 billion dollars!
body: This isn't just a corporate handshake; it's a huge win for the AI community. Hugging Face is the go-to platform for open-source machine learning models and tools. With NVIDIA's resources, they plan to massively scale the platform, strengthen infrastructure, and make AI more accessible for developers globally. This could supercharge innovation, especially for those building with open-source models.
